mood: Dark premium SaaS, clean, fast, trustworthy, highly professional. Linear.app style combined with clinical trust. Generous whitespace, micro-animations, glass-morphism.

typography.caption: text-sm text-[#8888A0] uppercase tracking-wider
typography.note: Inter is banned. Headings use Outfit for a clean tech aesthetic, body uses Work Sans for readability.

glass.usage: Sticky headers, ARIA chat panel, detail drawers, modals

layout_and_spacing.sidebar: w-64 border-r border-[rgba(255,255,255,0.07)] bg-[#0A0A0F] transition-all duration-300
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Strict geometric alignment, left-aligned content for scanning, negative space prioritized.

aria_orb.breathing: scale(1.0) to scale(1.05) infinite alternate (use CSS keyframes)

motion.numbers_animate: framer-motion counter animation on value change for stats

buttons.primary: bg-[#6C63FF] text-white hover:bg-[#6C63FF]/90 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-all shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(108,99,255,0.3)] hover:shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(108,99,255,0.5)]
buttons.secondary: bg-[#111118] text-[#F0F0F5] border border-[rgba(255,255,255,0.07)] hover:bg-[rgba(255,255,255,0.05)] rounded-lg px-4 py-2 transition-all
buttons.ghost: text-[#8888A0] hover:text-[#F0F0F5] hover:bg-[rgba(255,255,255,0.05)] rounded-lg px-4 py-2 transition-all
buttons.danger: bg-[#FF5B6A]/10 text-[#FF5B6A] hover:bg-[#FF5B6A]/20 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 transition-all

inputs.base: bg-[#0A0A0F] border border-[rgba(255,255,255,0.07)] text-[#F0F0F5] rounded-lg focus:border-[#6C63FF] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#6C63FF] transition-all px-3 py-2

aria_chat.user_bubble: bg-[#111118] border border-[rgba(255,255,255,0.07)] text-[#F0F0F5] rounded-2xl rounded-tr-sm p-4 text-sm
aria_chat.aria_bubble: bg-[#6C63FF]/15 border border-[#6C63FF]/30 text-[#F0F0F5] rounded-2xl rounded-tl-sm p-4 backdrop-blur-sm text-sm

components.shadcn_overrides: Do not use standard shadcn grey colors. Override all border, background, and ring utility classes to match the colors defined above. Use rounded-xl for cards and rounded-lg for interactive elements. Ensure JS/JSX files are used.

specific_page_instructions.dashboard: Bento grid mode. Feature ARIA as a fixed/floating panel on the right or bottom. Use glassmorphism for ARIA's container to overlay on the grid. Dashboard stats must use animated numbers (e.g., framer-motion).
specific_page_instructions.calendar: Strict grid, minimal borders. Active/current day marked with Accent 2 (#00D4AA). Appointment blocks use solid colors with 15% opacity and solid left borders.
specific_page_instructions.whatsapp_inbox: Three-pane layout (sidebar, chat list, active chat). Use ARIA's violet bubbles for AI responses and dark gray for user/patient.
specific_page_instructions.patients_table: Dense control room grid. Generous row padding (py-4). Hover state on rows changes background slightly. 'Detail Drawer' uses glassmorphism backdrop.
specific_page_instructions.login: Use the dark modern architecture image as background with a heavy vignette/overlay (bg-[#0A0A0F]/80). Form is a central glassmorphic card.

accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, links, and key state elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case to facilitate robust automated testing.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Text contrast must meet at least WCAG AA standards. The #8888A0 secondary text against #0A0A0F or #111118 has good contrast, ensure it is readable.
